name: native-provider-web-search-discovery-and-followup
covers: hosted search within the selected provider

steps.prompt: Discovery only: use your provider web_search tool to find the title of RFC 2606 and its reserved second-level domain names. Name the exact title and domains and cite a source URL. Do not clone, edit files, run commands or tests, export, publish, or write to GitLab. Do not answer from memory: if search fails, report the failure.

Discovery only: search the web again for the publication year of that RFC and cite a source URL. Perform a new search. Do not clone, edit files, run commands or tests, export, publish, or write to GitLab.
